# catalytic-register-frontiers

> Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 formalization (13 module files, 18 theorems + non-vacuity = 20 audited declarations across 6 passing kernels), exact-arithmetic + Hypothesis + mutant + brute-force & second-encoder differential SAT + 8/8 LRAT UNSAT verification suite, REUSE 3.3 verifier, continuous RFC 3161 TSA verification, and AMS-LaTeX preprint settling the exact base-p digit-sum dichotomy for RP^{pass}_{F_p}(2, t), exact sharp F_4 separation (T1e), literal CRing/GF4 soundness bridges (T1s, T1es), distinct-operand bilinear Frobenius collapse (T2b), and globally optimal 3-register catalytic powering exponent (0.86135 -> 0.81071, T3a-T3g).

## Key Files
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, 5-second verbatim `#print axioms` proof, Statement-Fidelity summary, Quickstart, and Usage examples
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical agent instructions, invariants, and Build Standard v1.1.0 rules
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Machine-auditable Tier 1–4 claims ledger with explicit refutation/falsification criteria
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Epistemic scope, negative findings, and classified defect log
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Clean-room replication commands and replication log
- [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md): Append-only errata log
- [DEVIATIONS.md](DEVIATIONS.md): Append-only plan deviations log
- [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md): Full line-by-line Lean-to-literature Statement-Fidelity Audit Table
- [docs/literature-search-log.md](docs/literature-search-log.md): Dated prior-art and Crossref/DataCite/arXiv citation audit log
- [docs/legal-and-ethics.md](docs/legal-and-ethics.md): AI/CRediT disclosure, COI, licensing, and export-control self-screen
- [docs/reviews/01-10-pass-review.md](docs/reviews/01-10-pass-review.md): Playbook v1.1 10-pass adversarial audit
- [lean/Challenge.lean](lean/Challenge.lean): Zero-sorry specifications of all 18 exported theorems (T1, T1a–T1e, T1s, T1es, T2, T2b, T3a–T3g, T4)
- [lean/Solution.lean](lean/Solution.lean): Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 proofs (6 passing verification kernels; 20 audited declarations)
- [lean/Catalytic/Pass2Soundness.lean](lean/Catalytic/Pass2Soundness.lean): Zero-Mathlib binomial theorem & literal CRing / GF4-algebra soundness bridges (`T1s`, `T1es`)
- [lean/Catalytic/NonVacuity.lean](lean/Catalytic/NonVacuity.lean): Concrete 0 != 1 non-vacuity witnesses
- [lean/comparator.json](lean/comparator.json) & [lean/formalization.yaml](lean/formalization.yaml): Palomar Registry verification metadata
- [paper/main.tex](paper/main.tex) & [dist/Donahue_2026_catalytic_register_frontiers.pdf](dist/Donahue_2026_catalytic_register_frontiers.pdf): AMS-LaTeX manuscript and frozen PDF
- [MANIFEST.sha256](MANIFEST.sha256), [provenance/](provenance/), [REUSE.toml](REUSE.toml), & [sbom.cdx.json](sbom.cdx.json): Cryptographic SHA-256 manifest, RFC 3161 trusted timestamp, REUSE 3.3 SPDX annotations, and CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM
- [results/sat_certs/](results/sat_certs/) & [scripts/verify_lrat.py](scripts/verify_lrat.py): Archived CaDiCaL 2.1.2 DIMACS `.cnf` + ASCII `.lrat` UNSAT proofs and independent exact verifier
- [project.yaml](project.yaml) & [docs/launch/release-checklist.md](docs/launch/release-checklist.md): Build Pipeline Models v1.0.0 manifest and 41-item Playbook v1.1 release checklist
